Using the determinant formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 3 & 4 & -1 \\ 2 & -5 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ -5 & 2\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}3 & -1 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}3 & 4 \\ 2 & -5\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(4\cdot 2-(-1)\cdot (-5))i-(3\cdot 2-(-1)\cdot 2)j+(3\cdot (-5)-4\cdot 2)k \\  & =(8-5)i-(6+2)j+(-15-8)k \\  & =3i-8j-23k \\  & =⟨3,-8,-23⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
